docs.summary: DateRangeInput component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use DateRangeInput when you need to collect user input. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.
DateRangeInput should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility.

anatomy.description: DateRangeInput is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Always include labels
bestPractices.description: Every date-range-input should have an associated label for accessibility.

bestPractices.title: Don't rely on placeholders
bestPractices.description: Placeholders disappear when typing and shouldn't replace labels.

bestPractices.title: Show validation feedback
bestPractices.description: Display clear error messages near the date-range-input when validation fails.

bestPractices.title: Don't delay errors
bestPractices.description: Show validation errors immediately, don't wait until form submission.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate types
bestPractices.description: Use specialized input types when available.

bestPractices.title: Don't use generic types
bestPractices.description: Avoid using text type for everything when specialized types exist.
